name: Dendritic Cell Tumor

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunophenotypic Diagnostic Criteria for Dendritic Cell Tumors

criteria.description: Presence of spindle to ovoid tumor cells with vesicular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm arranged in fascicles or whorls
Positive immunohistochemical staining for dendritic cell markers such as CD21, CD23, and CD35
Exclusion of other spindle cell neoplasms and lymphomas by negative staining for markers such as CD1a, S100, and cytokeratins
Presentation with localized or disseminated lymphadenopathy or extranodal mass

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological features plus positive immunophenotyping for dendritic cell markers with exclusion of other neoplasms
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotype, and clinical findings.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically localized but can be multifocal
Commonly in head and neck, soft tissue, or gastrointestinal tract

common.symptomName: Constitutional B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)
common.notes: May be present in advanced disease

occasional.symptomName: Pain or tenderness at tumor site
occasional.notes: May occur if tumor compresses adjacent structures

occasional.symptomName: Neurological symptoms due to mass effect
searchTerms: neurological issues due to tumor size
immune system attacks related to cancer

rare.notes: In tumors located in head and neck region

laboratory: Mild anemia or cytopenias in disseminated disease
Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in some cases
imaging: CT or MRI showing well-defined soft tissue masses
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; rare cases show chromosomal abnormalities
other: Histopathology with characteristic spindle cell morphology
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD21, CD23, CD35

distinguishingFeatures: Positive B-cell markers (CD20, CD10) instead of dendritic cell markers
Positive for S100 and CD1a, negative for follicular dendritic cell markers
Lack of dendritic cell marker expression

redFlags: Compression symptoms causing neurological deficits or airway obstruction
references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Harris NL, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
Chan JK. Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma. Semin Diagn Pathol. 2011;28(1):38-44.
Saygin C, Uzunaslan D, Ozguroglu M. Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma: a review of the literature. J Clin Oncol. 2013;31(10):e1-e2.
